findings.finding: Original headers and Cosmos response classes inherit cosmosAADLong. New typed bucket copies and relevant legacy-contract functions now preserve it. Data operations use existing configured key/AAD factories; provisioning and cleanup remain key-owned. Marker/factory restoration alone is not evidence of live token-authenticated success.

Restored inherited cosmosQuery/cosmosAADQuery on both response-hook copy classes. Their configured-data-auth factories were already retained. This restores selection, not evidence of an executed live AAD lane.

Composite CRUD originally inherits cosmosLong/cosmosCircuitBreaker/cosmosAADCircuitBreaker; suppression composites inherit cosmosLong/cosmosAADLong. New create-only modules use cosmosEmulator plus account/binding availability gates. cosmosLong is now restored on both persistence tests. Original AADLong, circuit-breaker and AAD-circuit-breaker categories are now restored as explicitly requested, without waiting for lane execution.

New create legacy-contract modules declare backend=[rust,core-python], but ordinary conftest collection excludes core-python via ADAPTER_PARAMETER_MODULES/exclude_parameters. --include-legacy-tests or --noconftest changes that selection; it must not be described as unconditionally Rust-only. observe_native_create guards Rust against legacy fallback.

Original fault module blanket skip is deliberately not copied. Rust fault tests retain cosmosEmulator, add timeout(180), injection/no-injection and regional guard controls. regional_target rejects non-localhost endpoints before provisioning. No unconditional xfail was added by this audit.

Availability classes require multi-region/AAD-multi-region lanes; setup enforces at least two distinct regions. Original CREATE branch, three client/request strategy pairs and seven nontransient status/substatus vectors are retained in snapshots, not claimed migrated. Pushback14 excludes hedging dimensions, not supported create error/routing vectors. A simulated emulator routing test is not a deployed multi-region gate replacement.

Original session multi-write tests skip only data_auth_mode=aad because localhost topology injection is emulator-only. Keep that reason attached to the original scenario; do not transplant its skip onto unrelated Rust token/session coverage.

Boundary tests inherit four sync/async x legacy/Rust cases from point_read fixture params; Rust regression module overrides point_read with only two Rust cases. Fake units omit live feature gates intentionally, without establishing native execution. Client-default suppression gets False/True vectors and LSN gets no_response False/True, but the original four-write async suppression sequence is still not replaced by the three-write sequence.

limitations: Only offline collection and AST/guard validation were performed; no live execution or CI lane run.
